subject.title: [Bug] Telegram exec approval bubble not dismissed after clicking approve

question: Should maintainers close/adopt the open conflicting fork PR, or allow ClawSweeper to create a fresh narrow replacement fix in the target repository?
rationale: The bug and fix shape are clear, but the issue is already associated with an open external fork PR and ClawSweeper currently marks it as no-new-fix-pr, so automation should not create a competing PR without maintainer routing.

options.title: Close or replace the fork PR
options.body: Treat the open fork PR as non-viable unless a maintainer adopts it, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Telegram runtime.

options.title: Adopt the fork PR manually
options.body: A maintainer can take over the useful idea from the fork PR, rebase it onto current main, and replace the obsolete handler changes.

options.title: Keep waiting
options.body: Leave the issue open without new automation until the fork PR state changes or the contributor provides an updated target-repo PR.

recommendation.title: Close or replace the fork PR
recommendation.body: Treat the open fork PR as non-viable unless a maintainer adopts it, then allow a fresh narrow fix against the current Telegram runtime.

likelyOwner.reason: The open question concerns the native approval lifecycle and Telegram adapter shape introduced in that area.
